spec_family.name: Exterior Garage Door Repaint
spec_family.description: EA-based spec for repaint of existing exterior garage doors. Adapts NC spec (SF_GARAGE_DOOR_EXT_NC_v1) to repaint context with condition assessment, condition-driven prep intensity, and 4 substrate states (sound/chalking/failing/rust). Three substrate materials (steel/wood/composite) with condition-driven primer selection — sound-paint steel uses spot-prime only (wax sealed by existing film, unlike NC which requires full DTM). Sectional door articulation requires leapfrog painting technique. Bottom seal lifecycle management (remove/prop/reinstall). Door size (single/double) is primary EA rate modifier. Panel complexity (flush/raised_panel/carriage/windows) is secondary modifier. Condition modifier in PREP stacking pool. Gloss sheen excluded for RP. Pre-1978 RRP lead-safe gate. Door casing belongs to SF_TRIM_EXT_RP_v1.

includes: On-site condition assessment of existing coating (visual inspection, ASTM D3359 adhesion test, rust evaluation, moisture test, coating ID)
Lead paint testing for pre-1978 structures (EPA RRP Rule 40 CFR 745)
Complete exterior face of garage door assembly (all panels, recesses, window frame surrounds)
Panel edges at articulation joints (leapfrog painting technique)
Condition-driven surface preparation (sound: degloss scuff; chalking: remediation wash; failing: scrape + feather-edge; rust: SSPC-SP3 debridement)
Surface cleaning (TSP/degreaser wash for all conditions)
Panel joint caulk assessment and repair
Track and hardware masking (tracks, rollers, springs, cables, brackets)
Bottom seal management (remove or mask, prop during cure, reinstall after cure)
Driveway/apron protection (canvas drops — NOT poly sheeting)
Condition-driven primer application (DTM spot/full for steel, chalk-binding for chalking, acrylic for wood, alkyd stain-blocker for tannin wood, bonding for composite)
Two finish coats with leapfrog technique (standard or premium acrylic latex, satin or semi-gloss)
Articulation test (door opens/closes freely after painting)
Balance check (safety quality gate — spring adjustment is not scope)

excludes.item: Garage door casing/trim prep, prime, and paint

excludes.route_to: Garage door service scope (flag if degraded)
PROHIBITED — introduces orange peel on metal door faces
EXCLUDED — requires substrate perfection not achievable over existing paint
EXCLUDED — garage doors are visible from street, not economy-appropriate
EXCLUDED — utility surface, not architectural showcase like entry doors

excludes.item: RRP containment and lead-safe work practices
excludes.route_to: Lead-safe certified contractor scope — triggered by positive lead test on pre-1978 structures

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier controlling pace, scrutiny level, intercoat sanding, and defect tolerance.
configuration_dimensions.notes: QT3=standard (production pace, 6-foot visual, no intercoat sand). QT4=premium (slower pace, raking light at 3 feet, intercoat sand 220-grit, premium materials). QT2 excluded — visible from street. QT5 excluded — utility surface. Same 2-tier range as NC.

configuration_dimensions.description: Garage door substrate material — drives primer system, prep protocol, and failure mode profile.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Steel: degloss/scuff (sound) or scrape/feather (failing) or SSPC-SP3 debride (rust) + DTM spot/full prime. Wood: sand + fill + acrylic primer. Composite: mixed-material prep + bonding primer on delaminated overlays. Per-door capture for mixed-substrate projects.

configuration_dimensions.description: Existing coating condition — drives prep intensity, primer scope, and round configuration. Assessed on-site.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Sound: adhesion test passes, minimal prep. Chalking: chalk remediation + chalk-binding primer. Failing: scrape + feather + spot/full prime. Rust: SSPC-SP3 + DTM (steel-only). SS_EXT_SURFACE_RUST is steel-only (COMPAT-006). Condition is primary driver of RP cost variance.

configuration_dimensions.description: Panel complexity classification — secondary cost driver after door size.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Flush = baseline (continuous spray). Raised_panel = +10% (brush work in recesses). Carriage = +30% (meticulous overlay detail). Windows is additive time (independent of panel type). Same as NC.
Gloss excluded for RP — requires substrate perfection not achievable over existing paint. Satin is most common for garage door repaint. Key difference from NC which allows satin/semi-gloss/gloss.

configuration_dimensions.description: Primary application technique for face coating.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Spray is primary for garage door faces (large flat panels). Brush for panel recesses on raised-panel and carriage doors. Brush-only for small projects where spray setup is not justified. Roller is NOT valid — introduces orange peel on metal doors. Same as NC.

paintable_items.name: Exterior garage door assembly
paintable_items.counting_rules: Each garage door assembly is 1 EA regardless of physical size. Door size (single or double) is captured as a modifier within EA. A door assembly includes all panels, recesses, window inserts (if present), and panel edges at articulation joints.
paintable_items.notes: Single paintable item — reused from NC spec. Does NOT include casing (SF_TRIM_EXT_RP_v1 scope), interior/garage-side face, weatherstripping, spring hardware, or tracks. Substrate state assessed per door during condition assessment module.

variants.notes: Baseline RP scenario — sound paint on steel, spray. Degloss scuff + spot DTM prime bare areas + 2 finish coats.
Chalking steel door. Chalk remediation wash + chalk-binding full prime + 2 finish coats.
Failing paint on steel. Scrape + feather-edge + DTM spot/full prime + 2 finish coats.
Surface rust on steel. SSPC-SP3 debridement + DTM primer on bare metal + 2 finish coats. Steel-only condition.
Sound paint on wood. Minimal prep + spot acrylic prime bare areas + 2 finish coats. 1.15x substrate modifier.
Failing paint on wood. Sand + fill + scrape/feather + acrylic prime + 2 finish coats.
Sound paint on composite/carriage overlay. Bonding primer only if slick surface exposed. 1.20x substrate modifier.
Any substrate/condition with window inserts. Adds window masking zone. Additive time (+0.75-1.25 hrs). Combines with any condition variant.
Brush-only on steel. No siding masking needed (no spray overspray). Brush is ~2.5x spray time for face tasks.

required_paintscope_inputs.description: Count of garage doors in scope. Each door assembly is 1 EA regardless of size.
Garage door substrate material — steel, wood, or composite.
Garage door size — single (8x7/9x7 ft, 56-63 SF) or double (16x7/18x7 ft, 112-126 SF). Primary rate modifier within EA counting.
Panel complexity — flush, raised_panel, carriage, or windows. Production rate modifier.

Existing coating condition per door — SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT, SS_EXT_CHALKING, SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT, or SS_EXT_SURFACE_RUST. Assessed on-site. Drives prep scope, primer selection, and round configuration.

required_paintscope_inputs.required_when: When application_method is spray (recommended for all methods)
required_paintscope_inputs.description: SF of driveway/apron surface within overspray/drip zone requiring protection.
Boolean flag for pre-1978 building. Triggers EPA Lead-Safe RRP requirements including lead paint testing.

valid_input_states.notes: 4 RP substrate states. SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT: adhesion test passes, existing coating is sound. SS_EXT_CHALKING: chalking degradation (common on south/west-facing doors). SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT: peeling, cracking, or delaminated coating. SS_EXT_SURFACE_RUST: steel-only, active rust at surface. State is assessed on-site by condition assessment module.

output_state.notes: Output state varies by sheen. Satin is most common for RP. Gloss excluded.

steel.notes: Spot prime bare/thin areas only. Existing film seals wax — no full DTM requirement unlike NC.

wood.notes: Spot prime bare areas. Tannin-rich species may need SYS_EXT_GDRP_PRIMER_ALKYD_STAINBLOCK.

composite.notes: Bonding primer only if slick surface exposed during prep.

all_substrates.notes: FULL COVERAGE mandatory. Cannot spot prime over chalk residue.

steel.notes: Spot prime if <30% bare. Full prime if >30% bare area.

wood.notes: Spot or full depending on bare area. Tannin species may need stain-blocker.

composite.notes: Bonding primer on exposed composite surfaces.

steel.notes: DTM primer on all debrided areas. CRITICAL: prime same day as rust removal. Steel-only state.

material_systems.name: DTM Primer for Steel Garage Door Repaint
material_systems.notes: Spot prime on sound paint (bare areas only). Full prime on failing paint or after rust debridement. Unlike NC, sound-paint steel does NOT require full DTM — existing film seals wax contamination.

material_systems.name: Chalk-Binding Primer for Chalking Garage Doors
material_systems.notes: FULL COVERAGE mandatory. Penetrates degraded chalk layer. NEW — not in NC spec.

material_systems.name: 100% Acrylic Exterior Primer for Wood Garage Door Repaint
material_systems.notes: Standard acrylic primer for wood bare areas. Supplement with alkyd stain-blocker for tannin-rich species.

material_systems.name: Alkyd Stain-Blocking Primer for Tannin-Rich Wood Repaint
material_systems.notes: Required for cedar, redwood, fir doors showing tannin bleed. May be spot or full surface.

material_systems.name: Bonding Primer for Delaminated Composite Overlays
material_systems.notes: Conditional — needed when composite overlays have adhesion failure or slick surface exposed during prep.

material_systems.name: Standard Exterior Acrylic Latex for Garage Door Repaint
material_systems.notes: Mid-grade 100% acrylic exterior latex. 2 coats with leapfrog technique. LRV restrictions apply.

material_systems.name: Premium Exterior Acrylic Latex for Garage Door Repaint
material_systems.notes: Premium 100% acrylic with superior UV resistance, self-cleaning, enhanced color retention. Intercoat sand 220-grit.

modules.name: Condition Assessment
modules.notes: MANDATORY first module for RP. Drives substrate state assignment, prep scope, primer selection, and round configuration. NEW — not in NC.

modules.name: Condition-Driven Surface Preparation
modules.notes: Tasks activate based on substrate_state and door_substrate. Condition modifier (FAC_GDRP_CONDITION) applies to this module's tasks in PREP stacking pool.

modules.name: Condition-Driven Primer Application
modules.notes: Primer path driven by substrate_state + door_substrate. Spot or full scope varies by condition.

modules.name: Second Finish Coat (Leapfrog) + Bottom Seal Prop

production_summary.rate_basis: EA (each garage door assembly) — minutes per door, not SF/hr or LF/hr

ea_conversion.notes: Same door sizes as NC. Rates are minutes per door, with door_size modifier adjusting for doubles.

time_estimates_by_scenario.scenario: Single steel flush, sound paint, spray, QT3
time_estimates_by_scenario.notes: Baseline RP scenario — excludes driveway SF protection. ~17% premium over NC baseline (287 min). Premium from assessment module (30 min) and surface cleaning/caulk tasks.

time_estimates_by_scenario.scenario: Single steel flush, failing paint, spray, QT3
time_estimates_by_scenario.notes: Scrape + feather adds significant prep time.

time_estimates_by_scenario.scenario: Single steel flush, surface rust, spray, QT3
time_estimates_by_scenario.notes: SSPC-SP3 debridement is highly labor-intensive. Steel-only condition.

time_estimates_by_scenario.scenario: Double steel flush, sound, spray, QT3
Single steel carriage, sound, spray, QT4
time_estimates_by_scenario.notes: Carriage adds brush detail work. QT4 adds intercoat sand + premium materials.

production_summary.worst_case_stack: Double (1.85) x raised_panel (1.10) x steel (1.00) x rust (2.00) = ~4.07x on prep tasks. Theoretical max with impossible substrate combo: 5.53x. Capped to 4.0x by engine.

protection_zones_required.notes: Driveway/apron below garage door. Canvas drops or absorbent mats — NEVER standard poly (slippery safety hazard). Mandatory for spray and recommended for brush.
Siding panels flanking garage door opening. Pre-taped poly or masking film. Spray method only.
Window inserts in garage door panels. HDPE static-cling film. Only when windows present.
Weatherstripping contact surfaces along sides and top. Low-tack tape deep in channel. NEVER paint weatherstripping.
Track, roller contact points, spring mechanism, cables, brackets. Must NOT be painted.
Bottom weatherseal (astragal). Remove or mask. Prop door 2-4 inches during cure. For RP: assess seal condition — recommend replacement if degraded (not painting scope).

adjacent_surfaces.notes: Garage door casing frames the opening. Different finish typically. SF_TRIM_EXT_RP_v1 scope.
Siding-to-garage door junction: casing intervenes. Siding masking is protection task, not edge work.
Driveway below garage door. Non-painted protection target.

site_condition_rules.effect: Substrate state assignment drives prep intensity, primer scope, round configuration, and condition modifier
site_condition_rules.notes: PRIMARY RP site condition. On-site assessment determines SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT, SS_EXT_CHALKING, SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT, or SS_EXT_SURFACE_RUST. Cannot be determined at bid time — requires field assessment.

site_condition_rules.effect: Pre-1978 triggers lead paint testing. Positive result activates RRP containment requirements (not this spec's scope).
site_condition_rules.notes: EPA RRP Rule 40 CFR 745. Safety gate — not common scenario for garage doors.

site_condition_rules.effect: Degraded seal flagged for replacement recommendation (not painting scope)
site_condition_rules.notes: RP-specific — existing seal may be cracked or hardened. Assess during bottom seal prep.

sibling_spec.relationship: NC sibling. Same surface (garage_door_ext), same ITM_GARAGE_DOOR. RP adds condition assessment, condition-driven prep/primer, 4 substrate states, chalk-binding primer, RRP gate. RP removes full DTM requirement for sound-paint steel, gloss sheen, environmental modifiers.

adjacent_specs.relationship: Garage door casing/trim painting belongs to trim RP spec. This spec covers the door panel assembly only.
Entry door repaint is completely separate. Different context prefix (DRRP vs GDRP), different PS keys.

cross_spec_boundaries.cross_spec_protection_note: Driveway/apron protection is THIS spec's responsibility. Adjacent siding masking during spray is also this spec's responsibility. Garage door trim/casing protection DURING SIDING SPRAY belongs to the siding spec.
deduplication_notes: Garage door CASING/TRIM painting belongs to SF_TRIM_EXT_RP_v1 — this spec covers door panel assembly only.
Driveway/apron protection IS this spec's responsibility.
Adjacent siding masking during garage door spray IS this spec's responsibility.
Entry door repaint (SF_DOOR_EXT_RP_v1) is completely separate — different context prefix, PS keys, and EA counts.

round_configurations.description: Spot prime bare areas + 2 finish coats — for sound existing paint
round_configurations.notes: Sound paint — adhesion passes. Spot prime thin/bare areas. May skip prime entirely if no bare areas found during assessment.

round_configurations.description: Chalk-binding full prime + 2 finish coats — for chalking surfaces
round_configurations.notes: Chalking requires FULL COVERAGE chalk-binding primer. Cannot spot prime over chalk residue. Common on south/west-facing garage doors.

round_configurations.description: Spot or full prime + 2 finish coats — for failing/peeling paint
round_configurations.notes: Failing paint — scrape + feather-edge + prime. Primer scope depends on percentage of bare area exposed after scraping.

round_configurations.description: DTM primer on bare steel + 2 finish coats — for surface rust (steel-only)
round_configurations.notes: Steel-only. SSPC-SP3 debridement to bare metal + DTM primer. CRITICAL: prime same day as rust removal to prevent flash rust. Most labor-intensive round.

issues.description: Intercoat tasks use appears_in_tiers in SOP vs qt_conditional_tasks in production — different structural patterns, functionally equivalent.
Baseline RP 5.6 hrs vs NC 4.8 hrs (~17% premium). Lower than expected 30% because sound-paint has minimal extra prep. Assessment module (30 min) accounts for most of the delta.
Theoretical max stacking 5.53x exceeds 4.0x cap but involves impossible material combination (wood + rust). Realistic worst case is ~4.07x.

doctrine_checks_passed: THREADING-1 through THREADING-6 (task ID completeness, classification match, applies_when consistency, UOM match, task prefix, module prefix)
EXT-1 through EXT-7 (key namespace, substrate state, protection zone, site conditions, factor keys, modifier math, material state)

GDRP-1 through GDRP-10 (EA rates, condition assessment, substrate state routing, leapfrog technique, bottom seal lifecycle, skip-prime for sound steel, QT range, sheen restriction, articulation test, RRP lead-safe gate)
COMPLETENESS-1 through COMPLETENESS-5 (protection zones, cross-spec boundaries, round configurations, module phase order, input declarations)

sequencing_notes.production_sequence: Assess -> Setup -> Prep -> Prime -> Finish 1 -> Interstage -> Finish 2 -> Final Inspect -> Cleanup
sequencing_notes.assessment_sequence: Visual condition assessment -> Adhesion test ASTM D3359 -> Rust evaluation (steel) -> Moisture test (wood) -> Coating ID (solvent rub) -> Lead test (pre-1978) -> Assign substrate state -> Select round configuration
sequencing_notes.protection_sequence: Driveway protection -> Siding masking (spray) -> Window masking (if present) -> Weatherstrip protection -> Track/hardware masking -> Bottom seal management -> Equipment setup -> Coating work -> Window unmask -> Weatherstrip unmask -> Track/hardware unmask -> Siding unmask -> Bottom seal reinstall (after 24-48 hr cure) -> Driveway teardown -> Articulation test -> Tool clean
sequencing_notes.leapfrog_sequence: Paint alternating panels (1,3,5 then 2,4,6) -> Open each joint to verify tack-free -> Paint adjacent panels -> Verify no bridged joints. RP NOTE: existing film thickness increases bridging risk — score bridged joints with utility knife before next coat.
sequencing_notes.coat_sequence: Assess (condition-driven) -> Prep (condition-driven) -> Prime (spot or full per condition) -> Finish coat 1 (leapfrog) -> Interstage (inspect, sand QT4, repair, dust) -> Finish coat 2 (leapfrog) -> Bottom seal prop -> Final inspect -> Touch up
sequencing_notes.key_prohibitions: NO roller application. NO back-rolling on metal doors. NO standard poly sheeting on driveway. NO painting on track/hardware/springs. NO spot-priming over chalk residue (must be full coverage). NO closing door on uncured bottom seal. NO skipping assessment for repaint. NO gloss sheen on repaint.

relationships.notes: RP sibling to NC garage door spec. Adjacent to trim RP spec (casing). Key RP differences: condition assessment module, 4 substrate states, condition-driven prep/primer, spot-prime for sound steel, chalk-binding primer, gloss excluded, RRP gate, 4 round configs, 56 tasks (vs NC 46), 9 modules (vs NC 8).

sections_used: §2 Wax removal protocol (RP: sealed by existing film)
DTM primers for steel (RP: spot vs full)

research_corrections.original_claim: Steel RP always requires full DTM primer like NC
research_corrections.corrected_to: Repaint of steel with SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT and passing adhesion test can use spot-prime-only. Wax contamination concern from NC is mitigated by existing sealed paint film. Bare/scraped areas still require DTM.

research_corrections.original_claim: Environmental conditions should be estimation modifiers
research_corrections.corrected_to: Environmental conditions are NOT estimatable — unpredictable at bid time. Excluded from spec per PaintFactor OS RC-003.

change_log.author: SpecFactory
change_log.changes: Initial draft spec for exterior garage door repaint. Adapts NC spec (SF_GARAGE_DOOR_EXT_NC_v1) to repaint context. EA-based single-item spec (ITM_GARAGE_DOOR reused from NC) with 3 substrate materials (steel/wood/composite), 4 substrate states (SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT/SS_EXT_CHALKING/SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT/SS_EXT_SURFACE_RUST), 4 panel complexities (flush/raised_panel/carriage/windows), 2 door sizes (single/double), 2 sheens (satin/semi-gloss — gloss excluded for RP), 2 application methods (spray/brush), QT3-QT4 quality tiers. 56 tasks across 9 modules (34 binary, 20 qt_scaled, 2 qt_conditional). 7 material systems (5 primers + 2 finishes — adds chalk-binding primer). 6 protection zones (reused from NC). 6 factor modifiers with stacking partition (PREP/COATING/SHARED/ADDITIVE). 4 round configurations tied to substrate state. Context prefix GDRP. Key RP features: mandatory condition assessment module, condition-driven prep intensity, spot-prime for sound-paint steel (wax sealed by existing film), chalk-binding primer for SS_EXT_CHALKING, gloss excluded, pre-1978 RRP lead-safe gate, environmental modifiers excluded. Maintains NC features: leapfrog technique, bottom seal lifecycle, articulation test, canvas-only driveway protection. QA result: pass (3 minor issues, 0 blockers).
